ITEM 1 | Irregular cluster of braised-looking chunks, grey-brown to tan with darker mottled patches, some pinkish-tan cut interiors showing a fibrous grain; soft, moist, slightly glossy, holding shape in rough blocks about 3-4 cm across, piled 2-3 cm high, centered on the plate | 150
ITEM 2 | Single curled green leaf with pale yellow-green midrib and stem, lying on the left side of the meat cluster, about 2 cm wide and 8 cm long, thin and limp | 12
ITEM 3 | Small scattered droplets of amber-orange liquid, glossy and thin, on the plate surface beside the bottom edge of the meat, each only a few millimetres across | 3
